bounded_oracle.scope: Two-day three-path finite miniature on the SAME dynamics/reward/resource kernel; not the seven-day held-out benchmark.

interpretation: No demonstrated score gain of primary trained Q over the corrected calibrated controller on fresh protocol2 seeds; paired interval includes zero.
Q reduces mean unserved units but spends more modeled cash and has different heat/holding/backlog outcomes. It loses58 of96 seeds by the declared scalar score.
Finite-budget MCTS illustrates actual tree search, but trails the calibrated controller and costs many online model calls. Increasing its budget helps this sample without establishing superiority.
An alternate RL seed has a catastrophic held-out failure; all seeds and negative outcomes are retained and primary seed is not replaced.
Synthetic seed holdouts, fitted authored records, and declared score weights do not establish observed company savings or high-fidelity business validation.
